def transform(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    colored=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (0,1)]
    if not colored: return out
    mask=[[1 if g[r][c] else 0 for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if mask[r][c] and (r,c) not in seen:
                q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=set()
                while q:
                    x,y=q.popleft(); cells.add((x,y))
                    for dx in(-1,0,1):
                        for dy in(-1,0,1):
                            a,b=x+dx,y+dy
                            if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and mask[a][b] and (a,b) not in seen:
                                seen.add((a,b)); q.append((a,b))
                comps.append(cells)
    for r,c,col in colored:
        comp=next(cc for cc in comps if (r,c) in cc)
        for x,y in comp:
            if all(0<=x+dx<h and 0<=y+dy<w and (x+dx,y+dy) in comp for dx in(-1,0,1) for dy in(-1,0,1) if (dx,dy)!=(0,0)):
                out[x][y]=col
    return out
''')
